summary: Comprehensive architectural implementation plan for refining the TrustLayer Invoice Sheet Design: Dedicated Received Invoices & Issued Invoices tables with exact 11-column layouts, separate Product Name and SKU columns, comprehensive independent multi-facet filters with pagination, PDF/image document upload with client-side preview and validation, clickable invoice inspection panel with linked inventory movements and reconciliation report, and strict separation of payment/decision/verification workflows while preserving recursive intelligence reconciliation.
